title: feat(research): bind strict plans to a sealed GL2 root
body:
## Summary

The actual strict Count selector now drives a sealed fixed-inventory GL2 physical root at width five. Its exact plan is `w=1,k=2,n=3,R=4,S=6`; the covering selector has no legal fit. This closes PR3553's reduced physical handoff and adds the nominal Tape-type adaptation needed by the physical return boundary.

```text
actual strict Count plan
  sealed physical root, four genuine rows padded to six
  completed return and immediate restriction
  second sealed root, completed return and restriction
  full original-chunk interchange, owned workspace erased
```

The isolated package is `research/sealed-strict-root`. PROOF.md supplies the scoped argument and complete charged-module invoice. RESULT.json records literal source-tape and parking traffic. The reduced binding supplies unit coefficients and terminal children only. Selected GL64 coefficient parsing, nonempty recursive parking, actual selected stock coefficients and supplier/outer admission remain open. No kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Pending [PR3562](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3562) retunes the original covering coupling and explicitly excludes strict padding. This package checks the actual strict-plan physical boundary and adopts none of that pending rate or proof.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3553 composed the actual selector with a logical callee. The first physical join failed its frozen return check because factory specialization turned `records.Tape` into a function.
  **After:** The nominal-type adapter preserves strict planning, scans, distinct output, head and disposal checks. Five complete fitted cases check 8,192 original columns and 24,576 summed padded-return columns; the actual no-fit fallback checks 192 more. Both root returns are checked before cancellation, with source/Count/outer-lease preservation, constructor sealing, reuse and final erasure.
- CPython 3.12 normal/optimized registered science, six completed-return controls and three actual optimized CLI rejection controls pass. The exact typed published receipts agree. Scoped Ruff, formatting, warnings-as-errors compilation, metadata/pins, final-HEAD bytes/source history and actual committed Git-free normal/optimized science/control replay pass.
- The 1,024-column fitted case charges 85,416,388 reads, 24,743,181 writes and 88,806,088 unit moves over the complete invocation. These are deterministic simulator tape counts; finite source compilation and host checker costs remain separate. Full inventory capacities are charged separately from observed pool peaks.
- Reproduce with `python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sealed-strict-root`. README.md includes committed-byte/history, export and exact Git-free commands. Runtime and mathematical premises are retained with exact origins, blobs and SHA256; replay needs no foreign Git objects or network.

Canonical baseline and submission checkpoint are `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The card premise is explicitly changed from deriving selected stock coefficients to the released concrete caller handoff. Credit Jose Manuel's physical caller, templates, arithmetic and root-session ownership; Nick Petalas's strict selector/consumer and PR3553; Hiroki Kumazaki's encoded selector; David Arias's Node/Driver; and the full retained lineage named in README.md and frozen notices.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Research.

One new isolated package. Frozen inputs and the selected record remain unchanged. This finite reduced certificate and source-dependent composition argument do not admit a physical supplier or prove an all-size multiplication theorem.
